---
title: "xtcore"
---

## Description

Adds ADSL core variables to an analysis dataset.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the parent dataset for adding ADSL core variables

  *Required:* Yes

**`outds`**

: Name of the output dataset

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `&inds`

**`filename`**

: Source file to use: SDTM_spec_Codelist.csv or ADaM_spec_Codelist.csv

  *Required:* No

**`filepath`**

: Path to source file

  *Required:* No

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xtcore(adlb);
```
